title: Canonical section and stalk comparisons for etale sum projection
statement: For a commutative ring A and an etale morphism e:V -> T of schemes, use the actual constant-A sheaf tensor, its tensor-on-sections map, the Kan-extension and sheafification units defining sum sections, and the inverse-image adjunction unit followed by graph restriction defining lifted sections. At each geometric point define the sum comparison by the germ-normalized exists_etaleSumStalksIso, the tensor comparison by the canonical monoidal stalk tensorator transported along the point universe-lift isomorphism, and the lift comparison by upperStarCompSheafFiberIso followed by its triangle-equation transport. Compose these to form the two vertical comparisons of the sum projection square. Its lower comparison is the actual TensorProduct.directSumLeft. These are precisely the unchanged definitions previously housed in the parent module.
